distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Yunnan and Taiwan under the current identity Euwallacea gravelyi. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently reports Taiwan under the source name Euwallacea barbatomorphus. Smith et al. (2022) independently reports Yunnan and Taiwan, supporting the existing reviewed distribution without changing it.

host_note: No host is promoted. Beaver & Liu (2010) reports the host as unknown, and Smith et al. (2022) provides no host in the curated record.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Euwallacea gravelyi (Wichmann, 1914).

taxonomic_history.name: Xyleborus ovalicollis
taxonomic_history.note: Published name currently treated as a synonym; original-description p. 193.

taxonomic_history.name: Euwallacea gravelyi
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Smith et al. (2020) reinstates Euwallacea gravelyi as a species. Beaver & Liu (2010) treated the Taiwan material as Euwallacea barbatomorphus and noted possible future placement within another Euwallacea species. That source name is mapped to the stable current identity Euwallacea gravelyi, VSN_2695; no duplicate taxon is created.
